action: Equinor partners and suppliers: no action required yet. Follow Equinor's official updates, treat unexpected emails that appear to come from Equinor with extra care, and confirm payment or access requests by phone.
exec: A major European energy supplier is under active attack; operations are reported unaffected, but the situation is still developing.
plain: Norwegian energy company Equinor said on November 17 it had detected an ongoing cyberattack on some of its computer systems. It says oil and gas production is unaffected and there is no sign that data was stolen.
summary: Equinor said it detected a cyberattack on its IT systems on November 17; production is unaffected and there is no indication data was stolen. On November 18 it said it is in dialogue with national security authorities, sees no risk of the attack spreading, said it did not come from a computer virus, and cannot yet say how long restoring will take. Reuters, cited by The Record, reported email was down. No attacker named.
title: Equinor detects ongoing cyberattack on IT systems; production unaffected

validation.note: Company statement, Reuters, The Record and Cybersecurity Dive.

review.note: Re-read The Record and Cybersecurity Dive (18 Nov): detected 17 Nov, production unaffected, no indication of data theft, not a virus, restoration time unknown, email down per Reuters via The Record; company statement not opened
